description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLog entity class in a Human Resource Management system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models logs of actions taken on timesheets, including properties such as action type, comment, date, user who performed the action, and associated timesheet.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: Entity class representing logs of actions performed on timesheets, with properties for action details, timestamps, and related user and timesheet entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieve the unique identifier of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Set the unique identifier of the timesheet action log.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieve the action type recorded in the log.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Set the action type recorded in the log.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieve any comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Set a comment for the log.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieve the date when the action was performed.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Set the date when the action was performed.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Retrieve the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Set the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associate a timesheet with this action log.
